verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners put the GLACIER logo under the headline, which inverts the brand order. The 'Find a Store' button is jammed right under the logo, and the five-line legal block is far too small to read at this size. A at least reads left to right from the can to the headline, CTA and then the legal text. B opens on the unreadable legal block at the far left, so fine print is the first thing the eye lands on. B also pushes the tiny can into the right edge next to a decorative circle, so the product loses its link to the message.
